sections.name: Volkswagen Virtus
lines: This is the Volkswagen Virtus. A mid size sedan, built in India on Volkswagen's M Q B A zero I N platform.
It comes with two turbo petrol engines. A one litre with a hundred and fifteen P S, and a one point five with a hundred and fifty.
The bigger engine makes two hundred and fifty newton metres, and pairs with a quick seven speed dual clutch gearbox.
A clever trick. When you are cruising gently, the one point five can switch off two of its four cylinders to save fuel.
The boot is huge for its class, at five hundred and twenty one litres.
And the big one. Five stars in Global N CAP crash tests, for both adults and children.
Top versions get a ten inch touchscreen, digital dials, ventilated front seats and a sunroof.
Solid build, punchy turbo engines, and top safety scores. A sedan for people who still love sedans.
